messages:
Anya Patel: Heads-up team 1514 026-03-30 - I pulled the RCX-512 RCA action table and there are four items without confirmed owners/dates. Need quick ownership confirmation so we can close the RCA by next sprint. Can folks ack or reassign?

Marcus Chen: I can pick up the migration test harness (generate deterministic traces + CI job). Estimate 2-3 dev-days. Targeting Tue 2026-04-06 for an initial run. Blocker: need staging GPU quota bump from infra.

Lena Ortiz: Ill take the canary validation + rollback runbook. Prefer to sync after Marcus's harness exists (for traffic templates). ETA Thu 2026-04-08.

Priya Desai: Quota change is in infra PR: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/3499 517 026-03-30. Waiting on @Elliot for a small autoscaler tweak comment. If merged tonight, quota available by Mon.

Elliot Park: Looking now, left two minor comments about the knob default. If we accept the tweak I can approve within a few hours. :+1:

Marcus Chen: Great, thx @Priya @Elliot. If PR merges Mon morning I can start Mon afternoon and still hit 4/6 for the initial harness run. Ill add a traffic profile file and a KV-cache warmup step to the harness README.

Lena Ortiz: small request  can you include a seedable traffic profile and a script to replay it? Means we get deterministic failures for the canary. Also add a brief validation checklist for metrics to watch (p90 latency, error-rate, token-drop).

Marcus Chen: yep will add /infra/test-profiles/rcx512-seed.json and replay script at /infra/tools/replay.sh. Validation checklist: adding p90, 99, error-rate, and kv-cache-hit gauge.

DevBot: Incident RCX-512 postmortem created: https://docs.redwood/incidents/RCX-512 4C4 026-03-30 - RCA action table linked. @Anya Patel set as coordinator.

Priya Desai: Quick timeline recap so calendar aligns: PR review complete Tue 2026-03-31 -> quota merge Wed 2026-04-01 -> harness first-pass Tue 2026-04-06 -> canary validation Thu 2026-04-08.

Elliot Park: I can fast-track review tonight if you want earlier merge. Otherwise tomorrow AM works for me.

Anya Patel: Thanks 44D Current proposed owners & due dates (please confirm or suggest changes):
- Marcus Chen 4BB migration test harness + replay script 4C5 due 2026-04-06
- Lena Ortiz 4C3 canary validation + rollback playbook 6A8 due 2026-04-08
- Priya Desai 527 infra quota PR & merge 4DD due 2026-04-01
- Elliot Park 50D infra PR review 4E2 due 2026-03-31

Anya Patel: If no objections I'll move these into the RCA action table and ping owners Wed morning for status. Can owners drop a one-line ack once theyve added details to the action row? :white_check_mark:

Marcus Chen: ack 44C - will update action row with links to harness dir and replay profile after first-pass.

Lena Ortiz: ack 44C - will populate the rollback playbook template and link canary metrics checklist.

Priya Desai: ack 44C - will follow up here once PR merged.

Elliot Park: ack 44C - will push approvals tonight if no blockers.

Anya Patel: Perfect. I'll update the RCA doc and mark these as "assigned (confirmed)". Plan: check-in Wed 2026-04-01 morning for infra merge status, then Monday 2026-04-06 for harness run notes. Thanks everyone.
